systems: openssl-src (the crate that builds vendored OpenSSL) documents OPENSSL_SRC_PERL as the override for the perl that runs ./Configure — the knob this change sets, rather than reordering PATH under a bash that ships its own perl
OpenSSL NOTES-WINDOWS.md: the native (VC) build needs a full Perl such as Strawberry Perl; the MSYS/Cygwin perl is for the MSYS/Cygwin targets, not the msvc one
Chocolatey/StrawberryPerl on GitHub windows images: C:/Strawberry/perl/bin is the preinstalled full perl; Git for Windows bundles a minimal msys perl without Params::Check
crux.verdict: No crux row is owed: CI configuration only, no shipped behaviour and no CHANGELOG bullet. openssl-src exposes OPENSSL_SRC_PERL and OpenSSL documents a full perl for the msvc build; this change selects the one the image already ships.
